# Replace NaN values with 0

anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset with the correct delimiter
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', delimiter='\t')

# Calculate the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Replace NaN values with 0
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['prop_gard'].fillna(0)

# Convert the 'habitat' column to numerical format using one-hot encoding
invaded_niche = pd.get_dummies(invaded_niche, columns=['habitat'])

# Perform correlation analysis
correlation_matrix = invaded_niche.corr()
correlation_matrix['prop_gard']
